doc.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe and Polcer thank each other and close the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’ve enjoyed talking to you.
Likewise, I’m a little bit hoarse here. I’ve been talking quite a bit.
I know we’ve fit a lot in. So best of luck, I’m sure we’ll meet on the road.

Well best of luck to you and this whole program. I’m really proud for you, of you and what you’re doing with this whole program because it goes to the core of who I am too. So thank you. It was really great. © Fillius Jazz Archive -23-
